description: Per-route JavaScript and asset performance budgets. Each route defines the maximum initial (uncompressed) and gzip (compressed) transfer sizes in bytes. CI fails when a route chunk exceeds its budget without an approved update to this file.
comment: To update a budget: measure the route chunk with `npm run build && npm run budget:report`, adjust the threshold below, and open a PR. Budget increases require reviewer approval from the performance owners (see CODEOWNERS). Never raise a budget to mask a regression; investigate the offending dependency first.
